facts.why: Sources give different years: Wikipedia says 1967, the Warner fandom page says 1969, TV Tropes says 1970. A single year is a risk.
Same year clash as the other dish: the sources disagree on 1967, 1969 and 1970.

facts.text: Poured while the popcorn burns on the stove.
facts.why: Mia does put popcorn on the stove and the fire follows, but the plot has no cocktail poured then.
facts.fix: A 1960s cocktail for a nervous night in Santa Monica.

facts.text: Mia's needle stops. The doll's head turns.
facts.why: Mia's sewing machine runs by itself in the film. No page read has the doll's head turning.
facts.fix: Mia's sewing machine starts on its own.

vibe.verdict: A decent 1960s home setting, but the years clash across sources and the dishes lean on generic retro party food.
